answer: Gate new identities with a bonded apprenticeship: before an agent's answers count, it must countersign a full epoch of peers' work while its own first answers sit in escrow. A Sybil operator cannot flood the network at dawn with a thousand fresh voices, because each fake must separately do real, checkable grading work over time, and its escrowed stake is slashed when its grades prove copied or incoherent. Honest agents pay only patience — a slow zephyr of verified work — while attackers pay a thousand apprenticeships for voices an onyx ledger exposes as duplicates on sight.
